title: Competitor listing monitoring and price position: competitor product pages captured and tracked by CIP itself, suggested matches, impact on our price and sell-out (spec section 9.9)
acceptance_criteria: Warren 2026-10-07: CIP's own competitor monitoring must be good enough that a separate scraper is pointless; CIP does not ingest anyone's scraper output
Competitor product pages are registered and polled by CIP's own capture scheduler, with polite per-marketplace limits, and each observation is stored with its snapshot
Competitor prices land in fact_competitor_price keyed to approved our-SKU to competitor-SKU matches
Suggested competitor matches are offered for steward approval; nothing auto-approves
Competition screen and the promotion line show the latest competitor price, our price position, and its history; empty means no rows, not zero
Impact view: our price gap to the cheapest matched competitor beside our sell-out for the same weeks, from stored rows only
Tests green on touched areas, tsc exit 0, eslint clean on changed files
